Feeders are first processed into Braille (i.e, “going in blind”) by converting each letter into a 2x3 pixel array, ignoring spaces in words when converting as per the flavortext, and placing them side by side. For example, AIRBUS translates to

![][image1]

[image1]: data:image/png;base64,

Inputting these resulting pixel forms into Conway's Game of Life, and counting the number of steps until they reach an empty board, yields

| Feeder         | Steps until termination | Extracted letter |
| :------------- | :---------------------- | :--------------- |
| AIRBUS         | 20                      | T                |
| BANANAS FOSTER | 21                      | U                |
| CHAPE          | 18                      | R                |
| DESOLATE       | 9                       | I                |
| EARTHLIKE      | 14                      | N                |
| FROUZIEST      | 7                       | G                |
| GIVE AWAY      | 20                      | T                |
| HEELBALL       | 5                       | E                |
| ISLE           | 19                      | S                |
| JUDICATORY     | 20                      | T                |

When the feeders are arranged in alphabetical order, A1Z26 yields our answer, **TURING TEST**.
